name: Menu Based Sidebar
author: WP-EXPERTS.IN

sections.description:
A smart way to display child menu items in the widget sidebar. The Menu-Based Sidebar plugin provides an option to display child menu items in the sidebar based on the currently selected parent menu item.

Features

 * Shortcode [mbs_menu menu_id=”MENU_ID_GOES_HERE”]
 * Display menu items in sidebar on based current main menu item
 * Auto display child pages on based of current main menu item

Note: If you are using any cache plugin on your website then please clear site cache after enable/update plugin settings

Please don’t forget to leave your valuable feedback and suggestions to make our plugin much better compared to other plugins.

 Have you any suggestion? share it
sections.installation:
Installing the plugin:

  1.  Unzip the plugin’s directory into wp-content/plugins.
  2.  Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Is this allowing to display child menu items in sidebar ?

 * Yes, on basis of current main menu item, it will automatically display their all child menu items in sidebar
 

Can I add sidebar under page content ?

 * Yes, You can use shortcode any where of the website where you want to display menu based listing
 

Can I show my footer menu items in sidebar?

 * Yes,Using the shortcode you can display listing of any menu, just need to add the menu id in shortcode [mbs_menu menu_id=”MENU_ID_GOES_HERE”]
